tips.text: Learn Kril's pipe mechanic before you go in: shoot the glowing coolant pack on his back, then hit him while he is frozen.
Run it solo; public squads rarely know the Kril mechanic and the mission drags.
Aim at the lit button on the pack, not the tubes; the tube hitboxes are unreliable.
Bring AoE or punch-through weapons like Angstrum, Simulor or Quanta, or ground slams like Rhino Stomp, to pop pipes without precise aim.
Leave Cold and Heat weapons at home; Heat thaws Kril instantly and Cold procs lengthen his immune windows.
Stop shooting once a pipe pops; if he has not slammed within a few seconds, step back when you are on top of him or close in when you are far.
If Kril keeps looping and never freezes, walk out of his range and back in to reset him.
Radiation-proc Vor so Kril turns on him; the slam that follows a popped pipe freezes Kril.
Farm a second Chassis blueprint here if you plan to build Chroma.
Expect about 5 to 10 clears for the full set; Kril's badly telegraphed phase is the only real complaint.
